label: Connatural cognition according to the knower’s mode
term: connatural cognition in ST I q.12 a.4
definition: Natural cognitive power reaches objects according to the knower’s own mode of being. A created intellect can naturally know God through a created likeness suited to it, as in the angelic example. Seeing the divine essence exceeds a created intellect’s natural power. Elevation by grace allows a created intellect to reach beyond that natural mode.
